scripts.build: node scripts/clean-output.mjs && node scripts/fetch-fx-icons.mjs && wxt build
scripts.zip: node scripts/clean-output.mjs && node scripts/fetch-fx-icons.mjs && wxt zip
scripts.test: bun run test:dc && bun run test:js && bun run test:types
scripts.build:firefox: node scripts/clean-output.mjs && node scripts/fetch-fx-icons.mjs && wxt build -b firefox
scripts.zip:firefox: node scripts/clean-output.mjs && node scripts/fetch-fx-icons.mjs && wxt zip -b firefox
scripts.test:dc: bun test src/core src/modules/settings-io.test.ts src/storage/update-keys.test.ts src/utils/sanitizeHtml.test.ts src/entrypoints/dc/composables/popupTabs.test.ts
